definitions.explanation: A visa that permits the holder to work in a country. In Japan, this is an informal term for residence statuses that allow employment, such as {技術|ぎじゅつ}・{人文知識|じんぶんちしき}・{国際業務|こくさいぎょうむ} or {技能|ぎのう} visas.

examples.japanese: {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
{就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}けない→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: You can't work in Japan without a work visa.

examples.japanese: {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}→入国管理局：24934_nyuukokukanrikyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: I carried out the work visa renewal procedure at the immigration bureau.

notes:
Composed of {就労|しゅうろう} (employment, working) + ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧ (visa). In Japanese immigration law, the formal term is ⟦{在留資格|ざいりゅうしかく}→在留資格：18891_zairyuushikaku⟧ (residence status) rather than ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧ (visa), but {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ is widely used in everyday conversation. Japan has multiple categories of work-related residence statuses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to obtain a work visa
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to renew a work visa
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧: work visa application
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: types of work visas
